audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[1] writes "Power Chords" (plural) but Sona's actual passive is "Power Chord" (singular) per the kit's ability list — flagged by the brief's suspectNames as a 1-edit-distance name error.
audit.why: The kit file is authoritative on ability names; the plural is a typo that a reader familiar with Sona's kit would notice immediately.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[6].side reads "Skill" while content win[6] already reads "Sona" — the full and content layers disagree on who wins Levels 2+ items.
audit.why: whys[6] and the late-game prose both already describe Sona out-scaling with doubled-range Crescendo and stacked Aria heals by 2+ items, so the content layer is correct; only the full-layer side/label was left on the stale generic 'Skill' token.
audit.corrected: Moved phases[6].side to "Sona" to match win[6]; win[6] is unchanged since it already reads "Sona" (no-op edit avoided per the chart rule).

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns has no cooldown number (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT). dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d are verbatim copies of tradeGood/tradeBad under unrelated titles (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED). report[8].t and report[9].t misgender Sona as "his"/"him". missingInteractions also flags that Sona's Q (Hymn of Valor) applies on-hit effects, which itemization doesn't mention.
audit.why: Crescendo (R) is Sona's only hard CC and the ability that decides the all-in; its real cooldown (140s down to 100s) is the concrete number the field is meant to carry. The on-hit note matters because armor alone underrates her Q trade once she has attack-speed items.
audit.corrected: Rewrote breakdown.cooldowns with real R cooldown numbers, replaced the copy-pasted dos/donts bodies with content specific to their titles, fixed both pronouns, and added the on-hit note to itemization.

edits.before: - Sona Crescendo: matchup-defining — The stun chord flips grouped fights — spread while it is up. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your E Full Tilt (remount speed) answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Crescendo (R) is 140s early, 100s at max rank — spent means the next fight is yours to start. - Hymn of Valor (Q) recasts every 8s flat, so her poke never really stops. - Save your own E (Full Tilt speed) for closing fights, not seasoning trades.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Dash W-Q the moment Crescendo (R) is down — she has no dash to answer, and Aria (W) can't shield the carry before your stun connects.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with intentions.
edits.after: Every second you wait mounted, Hymn of Valor (Q) ticks again on its 8s cooldown — patience just banks her more poke, not less.
